subject: Monthly KPI triangle readout — throughput / latency / cost (QBR prep)
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Monthly KPI triangle readout: throughput, latency, cost — QBR prep

Hi all,

Attaching the March KPI snapshot and the token-level cost/latency breakdown (see attachments). This is a short leadership readout ahead of next week's QBR; asking for 24h turnaround on comments. High-level observations from the dashboard:

- Throughput: sustained overall throughput up ~6% MoM driven by Acme Labs and two other mid-market accounts.
- Latency: 95th pct latency increased ~12% week-over-week on the text-gen tier; p99 shows smaller but notable tail (~8%).
- Cost: cost per 1M tokens has increased ~9% MoM after the Feb quantization rollbacks in eu-west-1.
- Uptime: brief availability dip in us-west on Mar 18 (99.97% -> 99.91% for a 2-hour window during the spike).

What I need from each of you:
- Jonas: quick hypothesis on latency tail (can KV-cache churn explain the 95th uptick?) and ETA for a short root-cause check.
- Laura: confirm impact to SLAs for affected enterprise accounts (Acme) and recommend communication cadence.
- Vivek: guidance on whether we prioritize cost regression (re-quantize) vs. latency mitigation for the QBR narrative.

Attachments: kpi_snapshot_mar-2028.pdf (dashboard export), cost-latency-breakdown_mar-2028.csv (token-level join).

I propose a 30-minute sync tomorrow to align talking points — calendar link in the thread if that works.

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Natarajan
Head of Product Operations — Redwood Inference
(Attachment: kpi_snapshot_mar-2028.pdf; cost-latency-breakdown_mar-2028.csv)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Monthly KPI triangle readout: throughput, latency, cost — QBR prep

On Wed, Mar 22, 2028 at 9:12 AM Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com> wrote:
> - Latency: 95th pct latency increased ~12% week-over-week on the text-gen tier; p99 shows smaller but notable tail (~8%).

Quick notes / initial hypothesis:
- We rolled a cache-keying change during the Feb canary in us-west that increased prefix cache misses for sessions with mixed-model routing. That would disproportionately hit the 95th (tail) while leaving median largely unchanged.
- I'll validate by correlating prefix hit-rate per model-variant across the affected time window (Mar 15-19). Expect a data pull by EOD today.

Plan: I will own the latency deep-dive and produce a 1-pager (root cause + mitigation options) by EOD tomorrow. If the hit is due to cache-keying, mitigation options are: revert keying + hotfix, aggressive pre-warm on high-traffic accounts, or per-account routing pins for enterprise tiers.

Attaching a short note with the rollout flags we used.

Jonas
Director, Serving Runtime
(Attachment: kv-cache-rollout-notes.txt)

From: Chris Ellis <chris@acme-labs.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Mar 2028 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: sudden p95 latency on text-gen during Mar 18 spike
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Hi Laura,
We launched a new A/B variant on Mar 18; query patterns jumped ~3.6x for a 90-minute window and we saw elevated tail latency on a handful of sessions. We rolled a rollback and saw tail latency normalize after ~40 mins. Happy to share logs if that helps.

— Chris
Principal Engineer, Acme Labs

--------------------------------

Laura here — Chris confirms a short but high-impact spike that overlaps the uptime dip. Priya, please include Acme's spike in the QBR narrative (shows product-driven traffic pattern).

Action request: can someone produce per-account exposure for Acme (tokens, failures, tail latency) and an estimated SLA hit for March? We need that number for the customer-note in the QBR.

— Laura
VP, Customer Success

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 23 Mar 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Monthly KPI triangle readout: throughput, latency, cost — QBR prep

Thanks for the quick flags. Two quick calls on prioritization and the QBR storyline:

1) Narrative: Frame this as a throughput-driven tail event amplified by a recent rollout (Jonas’ hypothesis) and external customer traffic spike (Acme). That gives us a clean operational explanation vs. systemic regression.
2) Prioritization: I want both mitigations scoped, but the QBR should lead with reliability (latency uptime impact/SLAs). Cost regression is important but secondary for the exec ask — we can include cost remediation as an engineering runway ask.

Requests:
- Jonas: please include recommended short-term mitigations with estimated RTO and customer impact.
- Laura: please calculate per-account SLA exposure for Acme for Mar (tokens affected, minutes of degraded perf).
- Priya: I want a one-slide summary for the execs that calls out root cause, customer exposure, mitigations and recommended ask ($/headcount or infra buffer). Put the slide in the shared readouts folder.

Link to the shared drive for artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cKPI-Readouts
I'll join the sync — scheduling note below.

— Vivek
